name: Kangaroo Island Marine Adventures
summary: Kangaroo Island Marine Adventures runs boat tours on the north coast of Kangaroo Island with the chance to swim with wild bottlenose dolphins. Tours leave from the Bay of Shoals boat ramp or Emu Bay jetty and the business closes over winter, from June to August. Owner and skipper Andrew Neighbour uses a jet-powered boat with no propellers.
standouts: Green Travel Leader, approved by Ecotourism Australia
First tour operator licensed to swim with wild dolphins on Kangaroo Island and in South Australia
Runs surveys and reports sightings for the Dolphin Watch citizen science program
Operates in the Kangaroo Island North Coast Mission Blue Hope Spot

trips.title: Island Explorer and Dolphin Swim Tour
trips.summary: A boat tour along the north coast of Kangaroo Island with the chance to swim with wild bottlenose dolphins in shallow, protected waters. Along the way you may see seals, sea eagles and osprey, listen to the dolphins on a hydrophone and view ancient fossil beds. The boat is jet powered with no propellers, and wetsuits and snorkel gear are included.
highlights: Swim with wild bottlenose dolphins, sightings not guaranteed
Listen to the dolphins through a hydrophone
Seals, sea eagles, osprey and ancient fossil beds
trips.duration: Usually 3 hours, sometimes longer depending on the day
trips.season: Peak season December to March, off peak April to November, closed for winter 1 June to 31 August
trips.departsFrom: Bay of Shoals Boat Ramp or Emu Bay Boat Ramp and Jetty, confirmed by SMS 24 hours before

trips.checkNotes: Prices are labelled 'Base Price'; the site says seasonal changes cause prices to go higher and to check the current price in the booking widget. No departure times are stated anywhere; time and launch site are confirmed by SMS or email the day before. The family price ($800) equals 2 adults plus 2 children at the base rates, although the homepage calls packages 'fantastic value'. The bookings page has four calendar widgets for 'Shared Tour Booking' and 'Private Tour Booking', each labelled 'Today to 31/03/26' (stale); which widget is shared or private could not be read from the page, so all four are listed. A site banner image shows '3hr Duration' and '15 Max'; a review mentions 15 people on a tour. Life jackets are optional; there are no change rooms at the departure points. Cancellation: full refund 48 hours or more ahead, half charged within 48 hours, full charge within 24 hours.
